name: @creatorkit/template-youtuber-portfolio
description: A one-page portfolio for someone with a channel. Static HTML, built on CreatorKit.

scripts.test: node build.mjs && node -e "const h=require('node:fs').readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8'); for (const t of ['c c-video','hero__title','deck-c','cta-newsletter']) { if (!h.includes(t)) { console.error('missing: '+t); process.exit(1); } } if (/{{[a-z.]+}}/i.test(h)) { console.error('unreplaced placeholder: '+h.match(/{{[a-z.]+}}/i)[0]); process.exit(1); } console.log('template: renders, no placeholders left');"
